fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-07-27 states that the complainant paid an advance of Rs. 65,000 for a machinery supply order, but the service was not provided and the payee stopped responding, on 2025-07-25 at roughly 16:40. Kalaiselvi Raman approached Erode South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000010. Sathish Sundaram (mobile 9000000372) was named as a possible person of interest. Manoj Karuppasamy (9000000054) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00116, as the mobile number 9000000372 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Payee reportedly stopped taking calls after receiving the advance.
fields.Keywords: advance payment, cheating, shopping complex, afternoon, digital document, suspect, witness, mobile number
